companies.title: Companies
companies.description: One per line: a careers page URL (boards.greenhouse.io/stripe, jobs.lever.co/spotify, jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion, apply.workable.com/huggingface, jobs.smartrecruiters.com/BoschGroup, acme.recruitee.com, acme.jobs.personio.de, nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite), a domain (notion.so) or a company name (Stripe). URLs are exact; domains and names are matched by trying the company's slug on every supported ATS except Workday, which needs its careers URL.

titleKeywords.title: Title contains any of
titleKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose title contains at least one of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. engineer, data, sales. Empty keeps all. Filtered-out jobs are free.

locationKeywords.title: Location contains any of
locationKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose location or country contains one of these, e.g. Berlin, Germany, London, Remote. Empty keeps all.

remoteOnly.title: Remote jobs only
remoteOnly.description: Keep only jobs the ATS marks as remote (or whose location says Remote).

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within the last N days
postedWithinDays.description: 0 keeps all. Jobs without a publish date are kept.

onlyNewJobs.title: Only jobs not seen in earlier runs (monitor mode)
onlyNewJobs.description: Remembers job IDs per board in a key-value store named ats-jobs-seen in your account. Schedule the Actor daily and get only new postings, so you pay only for new jobs.

monitorName.title: Monitor name
monitorName.description: Only for monitor mode. Runs with the same name share their memory of seen jobs; give each separate watch list its own name.

includeDescription.title: Include job description
includeDescription.description: Full description as HTML and plain text. Turn off for smaller, faster output.

maxJobsPerCompany.title: Max jobs per company
maxJobsPerCompany.description: 0 means no limit. Caps the jobs (and the cost) per company after filters.

atsSystems.title: Only try these ATS (for names and domains)
atsSystems.description: Limit auto-detection to some systems. Empty tries all seven. Ignored for careers page URLs (Workday is URL-only).
